SFUSD assigns schools after application using its rules and available seats; neither proximity nor an elementary attendance area reserves a seat. 2026–27 学年新生可全年联系 Enrollment Center；从 Ap: New students seeking 2026–27 enrollment can contact the Enrollment Center throughout the year. Use ParentVUE from the Apply page or the official paper/PDF process, then confirm the school, grade and start date.

住所、年龄及其他证明只按官网清单核对并交官方渠道，不发到本站或公开群。材料不齐、: Check residency, age and other documents against the official list and submit them only through official channels, not this site or public groups. Ask the Enrollment Center for help with missing documents, temporary housing or language support.
在读学生想换校，应查适用的转校流程；Spring Transfer 面向符合条件: Current students seeking another school should check the applicable transfer process. Spring Transfer serves eligible current SFUSD students and excludes charter-school students. A successful assignment automatically replaces the previous placement; it is not an exploratory request that you can accept or decline later. For attendance across district boundaries, check interdistrict permits with both the district of residence and the receiving district.

Ask about language programs, learning support, school hours, after-school availability and transport; try the journey in advance. A visit does not promise admission, and access to classrooms or school activities requires permission. Check program requirements for the intended year.

At San Francisco State, choose the appropriate applicant type in Admissions and use Visit Campus for bookings or self-guided maps. Both are separate from K–12 district assignment: living nearby does not replace an application. Confirm visit dates, accessible facilities and permitted areas with the institution.

新生、转校和看校分开办理: Handle enrollment, transfers and school visits separately
核验时 Berkeley、Mt. Diablo 和 San Ramon Vall: At review, Berkeley, Mt. Diablo and San Ramon Valley provided 2026–27 enrollment entry points; recheck the calendar for the next school year. New families should use official lists for residency, age and educational records and submit documents only through official channels. For a school change within a district, check intradistrict procedures; across districts, check interdistrict procedures with both districts for permits, seats and decision timing. A submitted application is not a completed assignment.
从学区学校目录进入校方网站预约看校，问语言与学习支持、课程、课后照护和实际接送。: Use the district's school directory to reach school websites and book visits. Ask about language and learning support, classes, after-school care and transport. Obtain permission before entering a campus. If standard residency documents are missing or interpretation is needed, ask enrollment staff about alternative verification and support; do not send documents to strangers.

County directories list additional community colleges. Check college eligibility, teaching locations, costs and visits separately; local residence does not establish admission or free tuition.
